data.one_liner: A flutter plugin that brings an in-background android app to the foreground.
data.what_it_does: Brings an Android application running in the background to the foreground. Allows passing optional actions and extras to handle specific logic upon bringing the app forward.
use_when: You need to bring your Android app to the foreground from the background.
You want to pass custom actions or extras when launching the app from the background.
avoid_when: Your target platform includes iOS or other non-Android platforms.
You do not want to manage Android background start restrictions or permissions.
strengths: Allows adding extras and actions to determine app behavior when brought to the foreground.
Simple API with a single main method.
weaknesses: Android only, does not support other platforms.
Subject to Android 10+ background activity start restrictions, requiring SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission.
data.setup_notes: Add SYSTEM_ALERT_WINDOW permission and have it granted by the user on Android 10 or higher.
